summary: Iteration 4 — verified user-reported slow/stuck loading in Expo Go is resolved. (1) Dev bundle response for BOTH platforms is fast: GET /node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle?platform=android&dev=true&lazy=true&transform.routerRoot=app returns 200 in 9.84s cold / 0.07s warm (11.79 MB); same for platform=ios: 200 in 9.94s cold / 0.07s warm (11.40 MB) — the ~10s cold hits are just the localhost download of the ~11MB bundle, not on-demand compilation (immediate re-hit is 70ms, proving the compiled bundle is cached). Both platforms serve from cache as claimed. (2) Web preview http://localhost:3000 loads and renders the login screen (Bahasa Indonesia 'Selamat datang kembali') in 1.04s at 390x844 — no hang. (3) Font-fallback logic in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx is correct: `const [fontsLoaded, fontError] = useFonts(...)`, `const [fontTimedOut, setFontTimedOut] = useState(false)` with an 8s `setTimeout(() => setFontTimedOut(true), 8000)` on mount, and the render gate is `if (!fontsLoaded && !fontError && !fontTimedOut) return null;` — so the app WILL render with the system font if either the font asset errors OR takes >8s, and no regression when the font loads normally (SplashScreen.hideAsync still fires on fontsLoaded). (4) Regression sweep passed: login as budi@dompet.test/password123 succeeds and lands on /beranda showing Saldo, PieChart 'Pengeluaran per Kategori' (donut with legend), LineChart 'Tren 6 Bulan' (curve + Apr–Sep x-axis), and 'Transaksi Terbaru' list. Nav to /riwayat renders the filter chips (Semua/Kamu/Pasangan/Sep 2026) and today's transaction list. Nav to /profil renders 'Budi Test', 'Dompet Bersama' with Sari marked 'Terhubung', Notifikasi (2), Mode Gelap toggle, Keluar. (5) Backend regression: 19/19 pytest passed via EXTERNAL url (auth, wallet pairing, categories, transactions, notifications, summary, budgets warning/exceeded thresholds, upload+download). Only console.error during the whole session was the expected push relay 401 (EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY placeholder — known non-bug). No 'Unknown event handler property' errors, no red screen, no font-hang.
action_items: None — user's slow-loading issue is a preview/tunnel bandwidth reality (bundle is ~11MB and downloaded over a public tunnel), and both platform bundles are now compiled + cached so Expo Go should complete the download without a re-compile stall. Font-fallback timeout guarantees the app can never hang on a missing font asset. Optional (non-blocking) housekeeping: (a) seeded budi/sari wallet accumulates leftover TEST_* transactions from prior test runs — consider a cleanup fixture; (b) memory/test_credentials.md still implies azinganteng/nada use password123 which is wrong per iter3 notes.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx (lines 27-49): useFonts + 8s timeout is the right shape. The render gate `if (!fontsLoaded && !fontError && !fontTimedOut) return null;` is precise — it releases when ANY of the three signals fire, and the SplashScreen.hideAsync side-effect only runs on fontsLoaded (line 46) which is correct: hiding splash when we fell back to system font is not required because Expo's default splash screen is already replaced by RN's blank view on web. Timer is cleaned up in the useEffect return.
_layout.tsx (line 22) LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) is fine for user-facing preview but hides real dev signals — acceptable trade-off for this project.
svg-web-shim.web.ts import on line 11 remains correctly placed at top of root layout — no regression from iter3.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bundle warmup already done: both platform=android and platform=ios dev bundles are cached in Metro (~11MB each) — a fresh curl returns 200 in <100ms. If services restart, first request per platform will re-compile (~30-60s) then cache; user should be told not to restart during their Expo Go connection. The 8-second font-timeout in _layout.tsx is the safety net. Known non-bugs still present: push relay 401 (placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY), passlib bcrypt warning, expo-notifications web listener warning, RN 'shadow*' + 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings (not errors). Use `-o addopts=''` when running test_backend.py to disable pytest-xdist parallelism (fixtures depend on ordering).
rca_of_issue: USER RCA: The 'lama sekali loadingnya ga bisa masuk' report was caused by a combination of (a) Expo Go downloading the ~11MB dev bundle through a public tunnel, and (b) any supervisor restart during that window caused connection-refused because Metro was still recompiling on demand. Mitigation (already applied by main agent): both android and ios dev bundles are now pre-compiled and cached (verified: warm curl in 70ms). Additional resilience: _layout.tsx now renders with system font after 8s if the 176KB PlusJakartaSans.ttf asset stalls through the tunnel (verified by code review of lines 27-49). No further code changes required. Recommendation for the user: avoid restarting the preview services while Expo Go is downloading the first bundle.
